title: Add a static route to a destination
summary: Manually add a specific route to the routing table, directing traffic for a destination IP or subnet through a specific gateway.

steps.explain: Add a route to a specific destination IP address through a gateway. This requires administrator privileges.

placeholders.name: DESTINATION_IP
placeholders.description: The IP address of the destination you want to route to.

placeholders.name: GATEWAY_ADDRESS
placeholders.description: The IP address of the gateway (router) to use.

alternatives.explain: Add a route to a /24 subnet (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) through a gateway.

placeholders.name: SUBNET_IP
placeholders.description: The base IP address of the subnet.

placeholders.name: GATEWAY_ADDRESS
placeholders.description: The IP address of the gateway (router) to use.

rollback.explain: Delete the specific route you added to revert the change.

placeholders.name: DESTINATION_IP
placeholders.description: The destination IP or subnet you previously added.

warnings: Incorrect routing can disrupt network connectivity for specific destinations.
Routes added this way are temporary and will be lost after a reboot.
